title.zh: 周一阅读考试和 -ion 单词

message.en: Reading Test is on MONDAY 23 November! Start with tonight's workbook. Spelling quiz is Friday 27 November.
message.zh: 阅读考试改到周一 11 月 23 日！先做今晚的练习册。拼写小测在周五 11 月 27 日。

message.en: The test is tomorrow. Do the lesson with Roy first, then the practice in order.
message.zh: 明天就考试了。先和 Roy 老师一起看课堂幻灯片，再按顺序练习。

intro.en: Go through these slides with Roy. Tap 🔊 to hear each slide.
intro.zh: 和 Roy 老师一起看幻灯片。点 🔊 听朗读。

items.en: Point of view: WHO tells it

points.en: Tomorrow's test is about 3 big ideas: point of view, perspective and theme.
points.zh: 明天的考试有 3 个重点：视角、看法和主题。

points.en: You already know a lot. Today we practise the tricky parts.
points.zh: 你已经会很多了。今天我们练习难的部分。

items.en: Narrator = the one telling the story
items.zh: 叙述者 = 讲故事的人

points.en: The narrator tells the story. The point of view tells us WHO the narrator is.
points.zh: 叙述者讲故事。视角告诉我们叙述者是谁。

main.en: "I love swimming!" shouted James. He jumped in.
main.zh: "I love swimming!" shouted James. He jumped in.

example.en: Cover "I love swimming!" Clue words left: James, He. So it is THIRD person.
example.zh: 遮住 "I love swimming!"。剩下的线索词：James、He。所以是第三人称。

points.en: Words inside speech marks are a TRAP. Do not use them for clue words.
points.zh: 引号里的词是陷阱，不要用它们找线索。

items.en: I, me, my, we = FIRST person
he, she, they, names = THIRD person

points.en: First person: the narrator is IN the story.
points.zh: 第一人称：叙述者在故事里面。

points.en: Second person: the narrator talks straight to YOU, the reader.
points.zh: 第二人称：叙述者直接对“你”（读者）说话。

points.en: Third person: the narrator is OUTSIDE the story.
points.zh: 第三人称：叙述者在故事外面。

title.zh: 第三步：第三人称有 3 种

steps.zh: 客观：不知道任何人的感受
有限：只知道一个人的感受
全知：知道所有人的感受

points.en: Ask: whose thoughts or feelings do I know?
points.zh: 问自己：我知道谁的想法或感受？

points.en: Nobody = objective (like a camera). One = limited. All = omniscient ("omni" means all).
points.zh: 没有人 = 客观（像摄像机）。一个人 = 有限。所有人 = 全知（omni 的意思是“全部”）。

title.zh: 看法：同一件事，不同感受

items.en: Farmer Tom: happy, his plants need water
items.zh: 农民 Tom：开心，庄稼需要水

points.en: Perspective = HOW a character sees something, because of their own life, beliefs and opinions.
points.zh: 看法 = 人物怎样看一件事，因为他们自己的经历、想法和观点。

points.en: The same rain, two different perspectives.
points.zh: 同一场雨，两种不同的看法。

items.zh: 概要：发生了什么（有名字）

items.en: Theme: the LESSON for everyone (no names)
items.zh: 主题：给每个人的道理（没有名字）

points.en: Summary: "Emma gave the photo card back to Sophie."
points.zh: 概要："Emma gave the photo card back to Sophie."

points.en: Theme: "Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours."
points.zh: 主题："Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours."

remember.en: If it has a name in it, it is probably NOT the theme.
remember.zh: 如果句子里有名字，那多半不是主题。

points.en: You have practised this all week. You are ready, Daisy!
points.zh: 你这周一直在练习。Daisy，你准备好了！

canNow.en: I can now find the narrator, the point of view, the perspective and the theme.
canNow.zh: 我现在能找出叙述者、视角、看法和主题。

intro.en: Read the word. Say what it means. Tap to check.
intro.zh: 读单词，说出意思，点卡片检查。

cards.back: WHO is telling the story. The angle the story is told from.
HOW a character sees something, because of their own experiences, beliefs and opinions.
cards.zhBack: 人物怎样看一件事（因为他们自己的经历和想法）。

cards.zhBack: 叙述者是故事里的人物，用 I、me、my、we。

cards.back: The narrator talks straight to the reader, using you and your.
cards.zhBack: 叙述者直接对读者说话，用 you、your。

cards.back: The narrator is outside the story and knows NOBODY's thoughts or feelings, like a camera.
cards.zhBack: 叙述者在故事外面，不知道任何人的想法，像摄像机。

cards.back: The narrator is outside the story and knows the thoughts and feelings of ONE character.
cards.zhBack: 叙述者在故事外面，只知道一个人物的想法和感受。

cards.back: The narrator is outside the story and knows the thoughts and feelings of ALL characters.
cards.zhBack: 叙述者在故事外面，知道所有人物的想法和感受。

cards.back: The one who is telling the story.
The words the characters say, inside speech marks " ".
cards.zhBack: 人物说的话，在引号里面。

cards.back: The message or life lesson of the story. NOT a summary.
cards.zhBack: 故事告诉我们的人生道理，不是概要。

canNow.en: I can now explain all 10 reading test words.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以解释全部 10 个阅读考试词汇。

title.en: Fill in the Blanks: Test Words

intro.en: Read the sentence, then tap the missing word.
intro.zh: 读句子，然后点出缺少的词。

items.text: The ___ is the one who tells the story.

why.en: Narrator = the storyteller.
why.zh: 叙述者 = 讲故事的人。

items.text: The words characters say inside speech marks are called ___.

why.en: Dialogue is inside " ". Cover it first!
why.zh: 对话在引号里，要先遮住！

items.text: I, me and my are clue words for ___ person.

why.en: The narrator is IN the story.
why.zh: 叙述者在故事里面。

items.text: You and your are clue words for ___ person.

why.en: The narrator talks to you, the reader.
why.zh: 叙述者对你（读者）说话。

items.text: He, she, they and names are clue words for ___ person.

why.en: The narrator is outside the story.
why.zh: 叙述者在故事外面。

items.text: A narrator who knows NOBODY's feelings, like a camera, is third person ___.

why.en: Objective = camera: only actions.
why.zh: 客观 = 摄像机：只有动作。

items.text: A narrator who knows the feelings of only ONE character is third person ___.

why.en: Limited = one mind.
why.zh: 有限 = 一个人的想法。

items.text: A narrator who knows EVERYONE's feelings is third person ___.

why.en: Omni = all.
why.zh: omni = 全部。

items.text: How a character sees something, because of their own life, is their ___.

why.en: Perspective = HOW they see it.
why.zh: 看法 = 怎样看。

items.text: The life lesson of a story, with no names, is the ___.

why.en: Theme = the lesson, not a summary.
why.zh: 主题 = 道理，不是概要。

canNow.en: I can now use all 10 reading test words.
canNow.zh: 我现在会用 10 个阅读考试词汇。

intro.en: 10 questions, 20 seconds each. Faster answers win more points. Tip: cover the dialogue first!
intro.zh: 10 道题，每题 20 秒。答得越快分越高。小技巧：先遮住对话！

questions.q:
We packed our swimming bags and ran to catch the school bus.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: we, our. That is first person.
why.zh: 线索词：we、our，所以是第一人称。

questions.q:
Have you ever eaten durian? You will never forget the smell!
What is the point of view?

why.en: The narrator talks to YOU, the reader. That is second person.
why.zh: 叙述者在对“你”（读者）说话，所以是第二人称。

questions.q:
Sophie bought a photo card of her favourite singer. She smiled all the way home.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: Sophie, her, she. That is third person.
why.zh: 线索词：Sophie、her、she，所以是第三人称。

questions.q:
"You are my best friend!" Lily told Emma. Then they hugged.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Cover the dialogue first! "You" is inside the speech marks, so it does not count. Lily, Emma, they = third person.
why.zh: 先遮住对话！“You” 在引号里，不算。Lily、Emma、they = 第三人称。

questions.q:
"I won, I won!" Tom shouted. He held his gold medal high.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Cover the dialogue: "I won" does not count. Tom, he, his = third person.
why.zh: 遮住对话：“I won” 不算。Tom、he、his = 第三人称。

questions.q:
Have you ever visited a Thai temple? You must take off your shoes first.
What is the point of view?

why.en: Clue words: you, your. The narrator talks to the reader. That is second person.
why.zh: 线索词：you、your，叙述者在对读者说话，是第二人称。

questions.q:
James and Tom carried the bread to the hall. They put it on the long table.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We only SEE actions. We know nobody's feelings, like a camera. That is objective.
why.zh: 我们只看到动作，不知道任何人的感受，像摄像机，所以是客观。

questions.q:
Lily wanted to sing on stage, but she was scared her voice would shake.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know the feelings of ONE person: Lily. That is limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道一个人（Lily）的感受，所以是有限。

questions.q:
Daisy felt proud of her drawing. Emma felt a little jealous, and the teacher was delighted.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know how EVERYONE feels: Daisy, Emma and the teacher. That is omniscient.
why.zh: 我们知道每个人的感受：Daisy、Emma 和老师，所以是全知。

questions.q:
The swimmers dived into the pool. The crowd clapped and cheered.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: Only actions, no feelings. Like a camera. That is objective.
why.zh: 只有动作，没有感受，像摄像机，所以是客观。

questions.q:
Sophie was nervous about the test, and Lily was worried about her too. Their teacher felt sure they would both do well.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We know the feelings of Sophie, Lily AND the teacher. All of them = omniscient.
why.zh: 我们知道 Sophie、Lily 和老师的感受。所有人 = 全知。

questions.q:
Tom smiled at the new girl. He hoped she would sit next to him at lunch.
Which kind of third person is it?

why.en: We only know what Tom hopes. One person = limited.
why.zh: 我们只知道 Tom 的想法。一个人 = 有限。

questions.q:
It rains all day. Daisy is sad because her swimming lesson is cancelled. Farmer Tom is happy because his plants need water.
This shows that the two characters have different...

why.en: They see the SAME rain in different ways. HOW a character sees something is perspective.
why.zh: 他们看同一场雨的感受不同。人物怎样看一件事就是“看法”。

questions.q:
"Emma gave the card back to Sophie."
Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It tells WHAT HAPPENED and uses names. That is a summary.
why.zh: 它讲的是发生了什么，还有名字，所以是概要。

questions.q:
"Be honest, even when nobody is watching."
Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It is a life lesson for EVERYONE, with no names. That is a theme.
why.zh: 这是对每个人都适用的道理，没有名字，所以是主题。

canNow.en: I can now find the point of view and tell a theme from a summary.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以找出叙述视角，并分清主题和概要。

intro.en: Learn the key words, read the story, answer the questions, then write the theme.
intro.zh: 先学关键词，再读故事，回答问题，最后写出主题。

keywords.meaning: a small card with a picture of a singer
I felt sad and worried inside

keywords.zh: 她的脸一下子亮了起来（很开心）

keywords.meaning: happy and kind feelings in your heart

paragraphs: My name is Emma, and I love K-pop. On Monday, I found a photo card on the bus floor. It was my favourite singer, and it was very rare! I was so excited. I wanted to keep it.
Then I saw a younger girl at the back of the bus. She was crying and looking under every seat. "My sister gave it to me for my birthday," she said to her friend.
My heart felt heavy. I walked over and held out the card. "Is this yours?" I asked. The girl's face lit up. "Thank you so much!" she said. Her name was Sophie.
I did not have the rare card any more, but I felt warm and happy inside. It was a better feeling than keeping it.

questions.q: What is the point of view of this story?

why.en: Clue words outside the dialogue: My, I, me. That is first person.
why.zh: 对话外面的线索词：My、I、me，所以是第一人称。

questions.q: Who is the narrator?

why.en: "My name is Emma." Emma tells the story.
why.zh: “My name is Emma.” 是 Emma 在讲故事。

questions.q: How did Emma feel when she FIRST found the card?

why.en: Paragraph 1: "I was so excited."
why.zh: 第 1 段：“I was so excited.”

questions.q: Why was the card so special to Sophie?
options: It was a gift from her sister.
It cost a lot of money.

why.en: Paragraph 2: "My sister gave it to me for my birthday."
why.zh: 第 2 段：“My sister gave it to me for my birthday.”

questions.q: Which is the BEST theme of the story?
options: Emma found a card on the bus.
Doing the right thing feels better than keeping what is not yours.

why.en: A theme is a life lesson for everyone. The others are facts or a summary.
why.zh: 主题是对每个人都适用的道理。其他选项是事实或概要。

questions.q: "Emma gave the card back to Sophie." Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It tells what happened and uses names, so it is a summary.
why.zh: 它讲发生了什么，还有名字，所以是概要。

questions.q: "Be honest, even when nobody is watching." Is this a theme or a summary?

why.en: It is a lesson for everyone with no names, so it is a theme.
why.zh: 这是给每个人的道理，没有名字，所以是主题。

prompt.en: Write the theme of "The Lost Photo Card" in your OWN words. Remember: no names!
prompt.zh: 用你自己的话写出这个故事的主题。记住：不写名字！

write.model: It feels good to give back something that is not yours.

canNow.en: I can now find the narrator and write a theme with no names.
canNow.zh: 我现在可以找到叙述者，并写出不带名字的主题。

intro.en: Add -ion to make a noun: discuss → discussion. If the word ends in e, drop the e first: evaluate → evaluation.
intro.zh: 加 -ion 变成名词：discuss → discussion。如果单词以 e 结尾，先去掉 e：evaluate → evaluation。

words.sentence: The coach will instruct us how to dive.
Your stomach helps you digest food.
We had a class discussion about K-pop.
Please accept my congratulation on your win.
The detective will investigate the lost photo card.
Read each instruction carefully.
Do not violate the school rules.
The vet did an operation on the cat's leg.
The teacher will evaluate our speeches.
Avoid duplication: do not write the same idea twice.
Let's discuss the story together.
The police started an investigation.
Can you operate this camera?
Tom got a good evaluation for his project.
Remember to punctuate every sentence.
Fruit is good for digestion.
We congratulate Lily on her swimming medal.
Running in the hall is a violation of the rules.
Check your punctuation before you hand it in.

My cousin studies art at college.

Festivals are part of our heritage.

We commemorate the day with a festival.

canNow.en: I can now spell words that end in -ion.
canNow.zh: 我现在能拼写以 -ion 结尾的单词。

intro.en: Multiply: top × top, bottom × bottom, then simplify. A whole number goes over 1.
intro.zh: 乘法：分子乘分子，分母乘分母，再约分。整数写成分母是 1 的分数。

hint.en: Multiply the tops, then multiply the bottoms. Then simplify.
hint.zh: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母，然后约分。

steps.en: Can we simplify 1/6? No number except 1 divides both 1 and 6, so it is already in simplest form.
steps.zh: 能约分吗？除了 1，没有数能同时整除 1 和 6，所以已经是最简分数。

why.en: When we multiply fractions, we take a part of a part, so we multiply the tops and the bottoms.
why.zh: 分数相乘就是求“一部分的一部分”，所以分子乘分子，分母乘分母。

hint.en: Multiply the tops, then multiply the bottoms. Then simplify.
hint.zh: 分子乘分子，分母乘分母，然后约分。

steps.en: Simplify. The biggest number that divides both 2 and 20 is 2.
steps.zh: 约分。能同时整除 2 和 20 的最大的数是 2。

why.en: When we multiply fractions, we take a part of a part, so we multiply the tops and the bottoms.
why.zh: 分数相乘就是求“一部分的一部分”，所以分子乘分子，分母乘分母。

steps.zh: 约分。能同时整除 6 和 12 的最大的数是 6。

steps.en: Simplify. The biggest number that divides both 15 and 30 is 15.

hint.en: Write the whole number over 1 first. Then multiply the tops and the bottoms.
hint.zh: 先把整数写成分母是 1 的分数，再分子乘分子、分母乘分母。

steps.en: Write the whole number 3 as a fraction over 1.
steps.zh: 把整数 3 写成分母是 1 的分数。

steps.en: Can we simplify 6/5? No number except 1 divides both 6 and 5, so it is already in simplest form.
steps.zh: 能约分吗？除了 1，没有数能同时整除 6 和 5，所以已经是最简分数。

steps.en: The top is bigger than the bottom, so change it to a mixed number: 6 ÷ 5 = 1 with 1 left over.
steps.zh: 分子比分母大，变成带分数：6 ÷ 5 = 1 余 1。
